description: Synthetic T3-style preference statements for a fictional developer. Mostly English with some Chinese, grouped into topics so that every target has topically close neighbours (hard negatives). Not derived from any real user's memories.

memories.text: Commits each feature separately instead of bundling unrelated changes into one commit.
Squashes a feature branch into a single commit before merging it into main.
Rebases feature branches onto main rather than creating merge commits.
Writes commit subjects in the imperative mood, e.g. 'Add retry to fetcher', not 'Added retry'.
Prefixes commit subjects with Conventional Commits types such as feat:, fix: and docs:.
Never force-pushes to a branch that another person has checked out.
Names branches with a type prefix such as feat/, fix/ or chore/.
Keeps pull requests under about 400 changed lines so they can be reviewed in one sitting.
Signs all commits with an SSH key.
Deletes feature branches right after they are merged.
Keeps every commit on main buildable so that git bisect works.
提交前先跑一遍 pre-commit 钩子，没通过就不提交。
Validates a new pipeline end to end on mock data first, before pointing it at real inputs.
Never shows fake or placeholder data in a demo; demos run on real records.
Builds test fixtures from a small anonymised sample of production data.
Writes a failing test that reproduces a bug before fixing it.
Avoids snapshot tests because they get re-approved without anyone reading the diff.
Prefers a few integration tests over many unit tests that rely on heavy mocking.
Fixes random seeds in tests so that failures are reproducible.
Runs the full test suite locally before pushing.
Does not chase a coverage percentage; covers the risky code paths instead.
Uses a copy of real data in the staging environment instead of generated records.
单元测试不连网络，外部服务一律换成本地替身。
Wants answers to start with the conclusion, with the reasoning after it.
Prefers replies of a few lines unless more detail is asked for.
When learning an unfamiliar topic, wants a detailed explanation that includes a worked example.
Wants shell commands shown together with the directory they should be run from.
Wants claims about library behaviour backed by a link to the official docs.
Likes comparisons between options laid out as a table rather than paragraphs.
Prefers diagrams written as Mermaid in Markdown instead of image files.
Wants code feedback to point at a specific line rather than give general advice.
解释报错时先讲原因，再讲怎么改。
Manages Python dependencies with Poetry and commits the lock file.
Pins exact dependency versions in the requirements files of deployed services.
Adds type hints to every public function.
Runs mypy in strict mode in CI.
Formats Python code with a 100-character line length.
Uses dataclasses instead of plain dicts for structured records.
Never uses wildcard imports.
Uses pathlib instead of os.path for file paths.
Python 脚本的命令行入口统一用 argparse，不用 click。
Stores flexible attributes in a Postgres JSONB column rather than an entity-attribute-value table.
Uses SQLite for throwaway prototypes and one-off local scripts.
Reads every auto-generated schema migration by hand before applying it.
Writes raw SQL for reporting queries instead of going through the ORM.
Soft-deletes user-facing records with a deleted_at column instead of removing rows.
Uses UUIDs rather than auto-increment integers as public identifiers.
Takes a database backup before running any migration in production.
Adds an index to every foreign-key column.
时间字段一律按 UTC 存储，展示时再转换成本地时区。
Styles React components with Tailwind utility classes.
Keeps styles for the shared design-system package in CSS modules next to each component.
Enables strict mode in every TypeScript project.
Avoids Redux; uses React context plus a server-state library instead.
Designs dark mode from the start rather than retrofitting it later.
Gives every icon button a visible text label.
Starts new frontend projects with Vite.
Avoids scroll-triggered entrance animations on content pages.
表单校验的错误提示显示在对应输入框下方，不要用弹窗。
Runs local dependencies such as databases and queues with docker compose.
Does not use Kubernetes for single-service projects.
Reads configuration from environment variables and never commits config files that contain secrets.
Deploys to staging and checks it there before promoting to production.
Does not deploy to production on Friday afternoons.
Emits structured JSON logs from services.
Adds a /health endpoint to every service.
Writes down the rollback steps before starting a deploy.
Ships risky changes behind a feature flag so they can be switched off without a redeploy.
生产环境的密钥放在密钥管理服务里，不写进 .env 文件。
Tries to review teammates' pull requests within one working day.
Marks non-blocking review comments with 'nit:'.
Does not merge their own pull request without at least one approval.
Expects a pull request description to explain why the change is needed, not only what changed.
Attaches before and after screenshots to any pull request that changes the UI.
Only merges when CI is green and never overrides a failing check.
Requires two approvals on pull requests that touch authentication code.
review 意见尽量给出具体改法，而不是只说这里写得不好。
Puts a copy-paste quickstart at the top of every README.
Records architecture decisions as short ADR files under docs/adr.
Writes docstrings that explain why the code exists, not what it does line by line.
Updates the CHANGELOG in the same pull request as the change.
Does not publish auto-generated API reference docs without hand-written examples.
文档里的命令都要能直接复制运行。
Keeps mornings free of meetings for focused work.
Prefers written asynchronous stand-ups over a daily stand-up call.
Does not check work chat on weekends.
Works in 50-minute blocks with 10-minute breaks in between.
Blocks focus time on the calendar a week in advance.
Declines meetings that have no agenda.
Writes a short note at the end of each day saying where to pick up tomorrow.
Groups meetings into Tuesday and Thursday afternoons.
下午三点以后不安排需要深度思考的任务。
Uses Neovim as the main code editor.
Switches to VS Code only for step-through debugging.
Keeps one tmux session per project.
Uses fish as the interactive shell.
Searches code with ripgrep rather than grep.
Keeps dotfiles in a git repository and links them with GNU stow.
Uses a light editor theme during the day and a dark one at night.
终端字体用 JetBrains Mono，字号 14。
Prefers early returns over deeply nested if/else blocks.
Never catches bare exceptions; always catches the specific error type.
Lets unexpected errors crash loudly instead of logging them and carrying on.
Wraps outbound network calls in retries with exponential backoff.
Keeps functions under about 40 lines.
Avoids abbreviations in variable names.
Writes comments only where the code cannot explain itself.
Logs an error's context once at the service boundary rather than at every layer.
错误信息要写清楚用户下一步应该怎么做。
Keeps processing of personal data on the local machine whenever possible.
Masks tokens and passwords before anything is written to logs.
Runs a dependency vulnerability audit every week.
Enables hardware-key two-factor authentication on every developer account.
Creates API tokens with the narrowest scopes the task needs.
接入第三方 SDK 之前先确认它会上传哪些数据。
Establishes a simple baseline before trying a complex model.
Keeps a fixed holdout set that is never used for tuning.
Logs each experiment's config and metrics to a file next to its checkpoint.
Reports the sample size alongside every metric.
Prototypes with a small model locally before renting GPUs.
Does not tune on the test set to push a leaderboard number up.
Uses notebooks only for exploration and moves any reused code into modules.
Runs each experiment with three seeds and reports the spread.
训练数据先人工抽查几十条，再决定要不要清洗。
Reviews new vocabulary with spaced-repetition flashcards.
Solves one algorithm problem every morning.
Checks understanding of a concept by explaining it back in their own words.
Reads a library's source code when its docs are unclear.
Watches technical talks at 1.5x speed with subtitles on.
学新框架先照着官方教程做一遍，再自己改着玩。
Cuts scope down to a working minimum before adding features.
Tracks tasks as GitHub issues rather than in a separate tool.
Works on one task at a time and finishes it before starting the next.
Reviews all open issues every Monday morning.
Demos progress every Friday, even when the work is unfinished.
Labels every issue by area and priority.
需求不清楚时先写一页说明，确认后再动手。
Uses plural nouns for REST collection paths, e.g. /users.
Versions public APIs in the URL path, e.g. /v1/.
Uses cursor-based pagination rather than offset pagination for list endpoints.
Returns errors as JSON with a stable machine-readable error code.
Writes the OpenAPI spec before implementing the endpoints.
Requires idempotency keys on payment-like POST requests.
接口返回的时间统一用 ISO 8601 字符串。
Drinks only one coffee a day, and only before noon.
Uses a standing desk for the first half of the day.
Listens to instrumental music while coding.
Keeps personal notes as plain Markdown files.
Goes to the gym on weekday evenings.
周末只看技术书，不写代码。
